translations.web: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: You fear the sword, so I will bring the sword against you, declares the Lord GOD.
translations.kjv: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword upon you, saith the Lord Jehovah.
